description: This Java source file defines the 'ZoneNode' class, which extends 'PcbNode' and includes a reference to a 'LayerNode'. It appears to represent a zone within a PCB (printed circuit board) structure, including methods for accessing its layer information.

classes.name: ZoneNode
classes.description: Represents a PCB zone node with a reference to a layer node, extends PcbNode.

methods.name: ZoneNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ZoneNode with a name, an index, and a list of children, and finds the associated LayerNode.

methods.name: getLayerNode
methods.description: Returns the associated LayerNode for this zone.
